method.value: Simulate thermalized spectra per Turner 1991 with background continuum; apply Snyder criteria and P/D factors

evidence.quote: Following the convention of (cite: 1991ApJS...76..617T), we simulated the spectrum of in each state with the assumption that the transitions of are thermalized

assumptions.value: Negligible beam dilution; thermalized transitions since n_H2 >> n_crit (~1e5 cm-3)

evidence.quote: As $n_\text{\ce{H2}} \gg n_\mathrm{crit}$, it is reasonable to assume that these transitions are thermalized toward MM1.

validation.value: Six vt=1 and three vt=2 clean features identified using P and D factors

evidence.quote: We identify a total of six $v_\mathrm{t} = 1$ features and three $v_\mathrm{t} = 2$ features

method.value: chi2 fit of single-Tex model to clean features only, with dV and Vlsr fixed to medians

evidence.quote: $\chi^2$ fitting is performed to statistically optimize the model and determine $T_\mathrm{ex}$ and $N_\mathrm{T}$.
The $\Delta V$ is fixed to $2.72~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$ and the $V_\mathrm{lsr}$ is fixed to $-6.90~\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$.

assumptions.value: Partition function approximated by sixth-order polynomial

evidence.quote: The torsional-rotational partition function $Q_\mathrm{rv}$ is approximated by fitting the total internal partition function as a function of temperature ($T$) using a sixth order polynomial

fitting.value: chi2 minimization; errors from inverse Hessian plus rms propagation (1 sigma)

evidence.quote: which include the fitting error derived from the inverse of the Hessian matrix and the error propagation from the rms noise of the observed spectra.

claims.hypothesis: Vibrationally excited acetic acid is detectable toward NGC 6334I
claims.experiment: Line identification with Snyder criteria and P/D factors over Bands 4, 6, 7
claims.result: Six vt=1 and three vt=2 clean features
claims.finding: First interstellar detection of vt=1,2 acetic acid

evidence.quote: We identify a total of six $v_\mathrm{t} = 1$ features and three $v_\mathrm{t} = 2$ features

claims.hypothesis: A single Tex model describes the emission

evidence.quote: The best fit yields an excitation temperature of 142(25) K and a resulting column density of $1.12(7) \times 10^{17}~\mathrm{cm^{-2}}$.

claims.hypothesis: Variation of AcA3 peak positions has a physical cause
claims.experiment: Compared peak positions of transitions across Eu and frequency
claims.finding: Explained by continuum absorption or outflows; cannot be distinguished

evidence.quote: we are not able to constrain which one of the two is the dominant mechanism that causes the peak-position variations

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Dust opacity vs outflow explanations for AcA3 shift both considered; undistinguished

evidence.quote: Although both of the mechanisms could account for the change in the AcA3 peak positions

evidence.quote: the uncertainties listed here might be underestimated as we have not incorporated the systematic uncertainties introduced by continuum subtraction.
